library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_table <- readRDS(file = "./input/TCGA_working_tables.rds")
# ── make_violin: core plotting function ──────────────────────────────────────
make_violin <- function(df, y_var, title_txt, comparisons = NULL) {
  res <- make_res(as.formula(paste(y_var, "~ cnv_cate")), df, comparisons)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = cnv_cate, y = .data[[y_var]], fill = cnv_cate)) +
    geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.20, fill = "white",
                 outlier.shape = NA, coef = 0) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("loss" = "#4F6DB8",
                                 "neu"  = "#B8B8B8",
                                 "gain" = "#EA6A6A")) +
     geom_signif(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      test = "wilcox.test",
      map_signif_level = TRUE,
      step_increase = 0.1,
      textsize = 5
    )+
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Immune Score", title = title_txt) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
make_violin <- function(df, y_var, title_txt, comparisons = NULL) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = cnv_cate, y = .data[[y_var]], fill = cnv_cate)) +
    geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.20, fill = "white",
                 outlier.shape = NA, coef = 0) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("loss" = "#4F6DB8",
                                 "neu"  = "#B8B8B8",
                                 "gain" = "#EA6A6A")) +
    geom_signif(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      test = "wilcox.test",
     # map_signif_level = TRUE,
      step_increase = 0.1,
      textsize = 5
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Immune Score", title = title_txt) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),

      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
# ── plot_arm_IS: prepare data and call make_violin ────────────────────────────
plot_arm_IS <- function(is_df, armcnv_df, arm, label_prefix, groups, comparisons) {
  if (!(arm %in% colnames(armcnv_df))) {
    message(paste("Skipping", arm, "- not found in", label_prefix))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  common    <- intersect(rownames(is_df), rownames(armcnv_df))
  is_df     <- is_df[common, , drop = FALSE]
  armcnv_df <- armcnv_df[common, , drop = FALSE]
  cnv_status <- case_when(
    armcnv_df[[arm]] >  0.2 ~ "gain",
    armcnv_df[[arm]] < -0.2 ~ "loss",
    TRUE                    ~ "neu"
  )
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Ranked_Sum = is_df$Ranked_Sum,
    cnv_cate   = factor(cnv_status, levels = c("loss", "neu", "gain"))
  )
  plot_df <- plot_df[plot_df$cnv_cate %in% groups, ]
  plot_df$cnv_cate <- droplevels(plot_df$cnv_cate)
  make_violin(
    df          = plot_df,
    y_var       = "Ranked_Sum",
    title_txt   = paste(label_prefix, gsub("Arm", "", arm)),
    comparisons = comparisons
  )
}
# ── arm config: each arm independently specifies which groups to display and comparison pairs ──
arm_config <- list(
  PAAD = list(
    Arm1q = list(groups      = c("neu", "gain"),
                 comparisons = list(c("neu", "gain"))),
    Arm6q = list(groups      = c("loss", "neu"),
                 comparisons = list(c("loss", "neu"))),
    Arm9p = list(groups      = c("loss", "neu", "gain"),
                 comparisons = list(c("loss", "neu"), c("neu", "gain")))
  ),
  SKCM = list(
    Arm6q = list(groups      = c("loss", "neu", "gain"),
                 comparisons = list(c("loss", "neu"), c("neu", "gain"))),
 #   Arm9p = list(groups      = c("loss", "neu", "gain"),
 #                 comparisons = list(c("loss", "neu"), c("neu", "gain")))
     Arm1q = list(groups      = c( "neu", "gain"),
                  comparisons = list(c("neu", "gain")))
  ),
  HNSC_HPVneg = list(
    Arm5q  = list(groups      = c("loss", "neu", "gain"),
                  comparisons = list(c("loss", "neu"), c("neu", "gain"))),
    Arm9p  = list(groups      = c("loss", "neu", "gain"),
                  comparisons = list(c("loss", "neu"), c("neu", "gain"))),
    Arm18p = list(groups      = c("loss", "neu", "gain"),
                  comparisons = list(c("loss", "neu"), c("neu", "gain")))
  )
)
# ── Main loop: generate and save all plots ────────────────────────────────────
for (cancer in names(arm_config)) {
  # get data by cancer type (HNSC HPV-neg is already a separate table, no filtering needed)
  if (cancer == "HNSC_HPVneg") {
    is_df     <- data_table$HNSC.HPVneg_IS
    armcnv_df <- data_table$HNSC.HPVneg_ArmCNV
  } else {
    is_df     <- data_table[[paste0(cancer, "_IS")]]
    armcnv_df <- data_table[[paste0(cancer, "_ArmCNV")]]
  }
  for (arm in names(arm_config[[cancer]])) {
    cfg <- arm_config[[cancer]][[arm]]
    p   <- plot_arm_IS(is_df, armcnv_df, arm, cancer,
                       cfg$groups, cfg$comparisons)
    print(p)
    }
  }
